modelNotes: Points Board 1.3 reads from nba_core.json, nba_minutes_engine.json, and nba_usage_engine.json.

Foundation uses scoring average, last 5 form, last 10 form, enhanced expected minutes, minutes confidence, minutes trend, usage score, usage trend, volume acceleration, shot volume trend, free throw volume trend, and starter status.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Gilgeous-Alexander will not play in Tuesday's preseason opener against the Pelicans, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
injury.detail: Gilgeous-Alexander will travel with the team to Tulsa but won't see game action. The absence appears to be part of Oklahoma City's plan to manage its primary rotation players throughout a five-game preseason slate, and there's no injury to report.

injury.shortComment: Murray is out for Sunday's preseason opener against the Jazz due to personal reasons, Katy Winge of Altitude Sports reports.
injury.detail: Murray is dealing with a personal matter, but it shouldn't affect his status for the regular-season opener. His next chance to play will come Tuesday in Utah. Tyus Jones should see an expanded role with Murray unavailable.

injury.shortComment: Sensabaugh won't play in Sunday's preseason opener against the Nuggets due to a left hip injury, Shreyas Laddha of The Salt Lake Tribune reports.
injury.detail: Sensabaugh's absence from Sunday's exhibition seems largely precautionary. His next chance to play will come Tuesday in a rematch with the Nuggets.

injury.shortComment: Reaves won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Kings after tweaking his ankle, Dan Woike of The Athletic reports.
injury.detail: The Lakers don't appear to be overly concerned about the injury at this point. Reaves will have another chance to make his preseason debut Tuesday against Golden State.

injury.shortComment: Sexton (undisclosed) has been ruled out for Monday's preseason game against the Kings, Dan Woike of The Athletic reports.
injury.detail: It's unclear exactly what Sexton is dealing with, though he's considered day-to-day. His next chance to suit up in the preseason will come Tuesday against the Warriors.

injury.shortComment: Miller (leg) is listed as out for Tuesday's preseason game versus the Nets.
injury.detail: Miller suffered a shin contusion during Tuesday's practice. Although there haven't been further details, his absence against the Nets is likely precautionary. The 23-year-old ended the 2025-26 campaign by averaging 20.2 points, 4.9 rebounds, 3.3 assists and 1.0 steals while shooting a career-high 38.3 percent from deep over 30.3 minutes per contest in 65 regular-season games.

injury.shortComment: Filipowski (back) won't play in Tuesday's preseason game against the Nuggets, Shreyas Laddha of The Salt Lake Tribune reports.
injury.detail: This will be Filipowski's second straight preseason game on the inactive list, so hopefully this isn't something that lingers into the regular season. His next chance to suit up will come next Monday against the Spurs.

injury.shortComment: Williams (not injury related) is out for Tuesday's preseason game against the Pelicans, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
injury.detail: Williams will make the trip to Tulsa but won't suit up for the exhibition contest. Oklahoma City is expected to spread the workload among its roster during the preseason, so Williams should have opportunities to see action later in the schedule.

injury.shortComment: Holmgren (rest) will not play in Tuesday's preseason opener against New Orleans, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
injury.detail: Holmgren will travel with the Thunder but won't take the floor. His absence comes alongside several other prominent Oklahoma City players and appears to be part of the team's preseason workload plan.

injury.shortComment: Hornets general manager Jeff Peterson said Monday that he "doesn't know" whether Knueppel (hamstring) will be available for the team's regular-season opener against the Nets, Owen Watterson of SI.com reports.
injury.detail: Knueppel's status for Opening Night remains uncertain as he continues to work his way back from his left hamstring injury. Peterson's comments suggest the Hornets aren't ready to rule out the second-year wing, though his availability will likely become clearer as training camp progresses. He has already been ruled out for the entire preseason, to be clear.

injury.shortComment: Kessler (rest) won't suit up for Monday's exhibition against the Kings, Khobi Price of The California Post reports.
injury.detail: The Lakers open up the preseason with a back-to-back set, so Kessler will sit out the first game, along with Austin Reaves. Kessler will likely make his Lakers' debut Tuesday against the Warriors.

injury.shortComment: Porzingis (undisclosed) remains out indefinitely, per Anthony Slater of ESPN.com.
injury.detail: The Warriors still aren't ready to offer up a return timeline for Porzingis, who's battling an undisclosed issue. The big man carries plenty of upside on a per-game basis in the later rounds of fantasy drafts, but he's reached the 60-game mark just one time in the past eight regular seasons.

injury.shortComment: The Hornets announced Monday that White suffered a left calf strain during training camp and will not play during the preseason.
injury.detail: White missed time with a left calf strain last season and is now in jeopardy of starting the regular season on the inactive list. If the 26-year-old guard is forced to miss time beyond the preseason, Christian Anderson and Dennis Schroder would likely see increased playing time.

injury.shortComment: Nurkic didn't participate in Monday's practice due to a right foot injury, Shreyas Laddha of The Salt Lake Tribune reports.
injury.detail: Nurkic logged 11 minutes in Sunday's preseason-opening win over Denver, posting four points (1-5 FG, 2-2 FT, 0-2 3Pt), five rebounds, four assists, one steal and one block. The big man can be considered questionable for Tuesday's preseason rematch against Denver until the Jazz offer an update on his status.

injury.shortComment: Wallace will not play in Tuesday's preseason opener against New Orleans, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
injury.detail: Wallace will travel with the Thunder despite being held out of the contest. With Oklahoma City resting several members of its regular rotation, younger players and roster hopefuls should receive extended opportunities Tuesday.

injury.shortComment: Williams will miss the preseason after suffering a right hamstring injury, the Hornets announced Friday.
injury.detail: Williams will be re-evaluated the first week of the regular season, putting his status for Opening Night in the air. Williams will have a difficult path to minutes this season as he competes with the likes of Naz Reid, Royce O'Neale and Tidjane Salaun.

injury.shortComment: McGowens (toe) is out for Sunday's game against the Timberwolves.
injury.detail: McGowens will miss the final game of the 2025-26 season, though to be fair, he hasn't played for the Pelicans since March 8 due to a fractured toe. He appeared in 42 games for New Orleans and made 13 starts, averaging 8.1 points, 2.1 rebounds and 1.5 assists across 21.0 minutes per game.

injury.shortComment: Topic (back) will not play in Tuesday's preseason opener against the Pelicans, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
injury.detail: Topic had been limited during training camp, so it's unsurprising that Oklahoma City will take a cautious approach with him in the preseason opener. The 21-year-old will travel to Tulsa, and his status will be worth monitoring ahead of the Thunder's remaining exhibition contests.

injury.shortComment: Hartenstein (rest) will not play in Tuesday's preseason opener against the Pelicans, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
injury.detail: Hartenstein will travel to Tulsa despite sitting out the contest. The veteran center is among several key rotation players Oklahoma City will hold out Tuesday as the club manages workloads during the preseason.

injury.shortComment: Williams (heel) won't play in Tuesday's preseason opener against the Pelicans, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
injury.detail: Williams is sitting out the first leg of this back-to-back set with heel soreness. Wednesday's tilt against the Bucks is his next chance to play.

injury.shortComment: Caruso will not play in Tuesday's preseason opener against the Pelicans, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
injury.detail: Caruso will still make the trip to Tulsa but is one of several rotation players being held out. The veteran guard should have opportunities to see preseason action later in Oklahoma City's five-game exhibition schedule.

injury.shortComment: The Hornets announced Thursday that Hall underwent a procedure to address a fractured right ankle and will miss the remainder of the 2025-26 campaign.
injury.detail: Hall sustained the injury in the G League Greensboro Swarm's playoff win over the Maine Celtics on March 31. The big man appeared in 19 regular-season games (two starts) with Charlotte, averaging 4.5 points and 3.9 rebounds in 11.3 minutes per contest. He's signed to a two-way deal with the Hornets and is slated to return next season.

injury.shortComment: Jones (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's preseason game against the Jazz, Katy Winge of Altitude Sports reports.
injury.detail: Jones tweaked his hamstring during training camp and did not practice Friday. According to Brendan Vogt of TheDNVR.com, head coach David Adelman said pregame that the goal is for the 25-year-old forward to be available for the regular-season opener against the Thunder on Oct. 22, so it wouldn't be surprising if he missed most, if not all, of the preseason.

injury.shortComment: Green (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's preseason game against the Nuggets, Shreyas Laddha of The Salt Lake Tribune reports.
injury.detail: The severity of the left knee issue is unknown, though Green will sit out Utah's preseason opener. His next chance to play in the preseason will come in Tuesday's rematch against Denver.
